title: Two More Minutes
can_do: 需要从喜欢的活动转场时，请求一小段明确的时间并按约定行动。
trigger: Mom says it is time to leave for the park while the child's drawing still lacks a sun.
core_response: Can I have two more minutes?
stretch_response: Can I have two more minutes to finish the sun?
repair_response: Just the sun, then I'll come.
setting: Finishing a drawing at home before leaving for the park.
essential_props: one drawing with its yellow crayon

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: It's time to leave for the park.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Can I have two more minutes?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: What do you need to finish?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Two minutes, just the sun. Then we go.

replay_cards.title: Leave the playground
replay_cards.change: Ask for time for one final slide
replay_cards.challenge: Dad agrees to one turn; take the turn and meet him at the gate

replay_cards.title: Pause the puzzle
replay_cards.change: Ask for two minutes to place the last three pieces
replay_cards.challenge: Mom sets the timer; finish or pause when it rings and come to the table

parent_support: Allow up to two minutes only when the schedule permits; agree on one small visible finish point.
The child can finish early. Once the sun is done, acknowledge it and leave together without another task or a language test.
